allow: Shell(git log --oneline -20 2>/dev/null; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -60)

Shell(ls -la vendor 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---SAIL---"; ls vendor/bin/sail 2>/dev/null; echo "---VENDOR COUNT---"; ls vendor 2>/dev/null | wc -l; echo "---DOCKER PS---"; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' 2>/dev/null | head -20)
Shell(ls vendor/bin/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---PEST VERSION---"; php vendor/bin/pest --version 2>&1 | head -5; echo "---PEST INIT?---"; ls tests/Pest.php 2>/dev/null || echo "no Pest.php")
Shell(find tests -type f | sort; echo "---FEATURE---"; cat tests/Feature/*.php 2>/dev/null; echo "---UNIT---"; cat tests/Unit/*.php 2>/dev/null)
